Maya (PM): quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — want to lock owners and timelines for the remaining actions. TL;DR: 4 open items, some recurring pattern on cache TTLs.
Trent (SRE): thanks — can you paste the list with suggested owners?
Maya (PM): sure. my suggestions:
1) cache TTL audit + add guardrails -> Olivia -> due 2w
2) rollout safety: canary + auto-fallback -> Leo -> due 3w
3) alerting gap: missing SLI for KV thrash -> Trent -> due 1w
4) infra cleanup: leaked temp volumes -> Ram -> due 2w
Maya (PM): I'll create the JIRA tickets after you ack owners.
Olivia (Eng): ack for cache TTL audit. will draft a checklist and share. :+1:
Leo (Platform): ack for rollout safety, but need a week to scope — can I push due to 4w if we need deeper work?
Trent (SRE): ack for alerting SLI, 1w is fine. I'll reuse the runbook fragment from INF-804.
Ram (Infra): ack for temp volumes, I need a co-owner for deployments cleanup — @Olivia can you co-own?
Olivia (Eng): yep I can co-own the deployments piece, but keep cache audit separate.
Maya (PM): updated: Olivia (cache + deployments), Ram (infra cleanup), Leo (rollout safety), Trent (alerting). I'll create JIRAs now.
RCA-bot: created INF-961, INF-962, INF-963, INF-964 and linked to postmortem doc.
Maya (PM): linking: INF-961 (cache TTL audit) -> assigned Olivia; INF-962 (deploy cleanup) -> Ram+Olivia; INF-963 (rollout safety) -> Leo; INF-964 (alerting SLI) -> Trent. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-961
Trent (SRE): added a quick SLI spike test plan in INF-964 comment. recommend we run nightly for 3 days post-fix.
Leo (Platform): added a note to INF-963: canary windows + traffic shaping config. tagging @Maya for approval on rollout thresholds.
Maya (PM): approved thresholds in the ticket. can we also add RACI for the audit item? who reviews and who signs off?
Olivia (Eng): reviewer = Trent, sign-off = Maya. I'll add that to INF-961 checklist.
Ram (Infra): for INF-962 (cleanup) — I'll create a small runbook and script. need a slot for one-hour maintenance next Tuesday.
Maya (PM): scheduling note: maintenance window proposed Tue 10-11am PT. ok? :calendar:
Trent (SRE): ok for me.
Leo (Platform): ok, but pls ensure canary run doesn't overlap with maintenance.
Olivia (Eng): noted. I'll coordinate exact deployment timing after Ram posts the runbook.
Maya (PM): one more ask — recurring incident pattern: ops noticed cache pressure spikes every ~3 weeks. can we add a tracking field to each ticket to mark "recurrence" and attach the spike logs?
Trent (SRE): will add a tag RECURRENCE=3w in INF-961 and attach the logs. also setting up a dashboard panel to track next 3 weeks.
Maya (PM): sweet. let's treat this as a potential systemic issue; if recurrence persists after these tickets close, we escalate to a cross-team task force.
Olivia (Eng): will include a small eval in INF-961 to measure hit/miss ratio after TTL changes.
RCA-bot: reminder set: weekly check-in for these tickets every Friday at 9am PT, starting next week.
Ram (Infra): putting owners+phone tree in INF-962. tagging oncall lead.
Maya (PM): thanks everyone. action: owners acknowledged, JIRAs created (INF-961..INF-964), dates tentatively set. I'll follow up in the Friday cadence. :wave:
Leo (Platform): thanks — will update INF-963 with rollout plan by EOD Thursday.
Trent (SRE): closing loop — I'll add the runbook links to the postmortem doc once INF-964 has the SLI tests.
Olivia (Eng): moving checklist to the repo: infra/playbooks/cache-audit.md and referencing in INF-961.
Maya (PM): perfect. if anything slips, ping here or DM. closing the thread for now. :lock:
